caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is composed of a vertical cylindrical wooden shaft, brown in color, with visible texture suggesting a natural, slightly weathered wood. At the bottom of the shaft, there is a large, round, metallic ball, shaded in tones of dark gray and brown with some red-brown rust-like patches, giving it a heavy and solid appearance. Near the top of the shaft, there are two metal bands or collars, also brownish-rust in color, that secure the upper section. Attached to the very top is an L-shaped metal component, similarly colored in reddish brown, with one end curving out horizontally before making a right angle and ending in a flat, rounded blade or striking surface. The object is rendered with careful attention to shadows and highlights, suggesting a three-dimensional form, and occupies the central area of the paper without overlapping any other objects or features.
title: Turpentine Hack
